title: A ghost ship ran aground in 1921. Only 3 cats were aboard. #shorts

scenes.label: CAPE HATTERAS, 1921
lines: A five-masted schooner is found stuck on Diamond Shoals, off North Carolina.

scenes.label: 4 FEBRUARY 1921
lines: Rough seas keep rescuers away for four days.
When they finally climb aboard, there's no crew.

scenes.label: THE CARROLL A. DEERING
lines: The log, the navigation gear and the lifeboats are gone.

scenes.label: CAPE LOOKOUT LIGHTSHIP
lines: Days earlier, a red-haired man had shouted to a lightship that they'd lost their anchors.
Witnesses said he didn't look or act like an officer.

scenes.label: APRIL 1921
lines: Then a bottle washed up with a note: the Deering had been captured.
But the man who found it confessed. He wrote it himself.

scenes.label: NEVER SOLVED
lines: Pirates? Rum runners? Mutiny? The crew was never found.
So who was the red-haired man?
Follow for one mystery every day.

youtube.description:
January 1921: the five-masted schooner Carroll A. Deering is found aground on Diamond Shoals, Cape Hatteras, with her sails set. When rescuers finally board on 4 February, the crew, log, navigation equipment and lifeboats are gone. Only three half-starved cats remain. A message in a bottle blaming pirates turned out to be forged by the man who found it. A federal investigation never solved the case.
